summary: Build practical climate-resilient food systems skills in waste valorization, regenerative agriculture, and circular agribusiness planning. Enquire today.
lede: Climate-resilient food systems training helps agricultural and food-business practitioners assess climate exposure and reduce resource losses across production, processing, and distribution. For professionals working with farms, cooperatives, processors, or value chains, it develops skills in climate-risk screening, material-flow and post-harvest loss analysis, waste-valorization assessment, and prioritizing practical resilience investments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape production, processing, enterprise support, and climate-resilient food systems programmes. It suits intermediate practitioners who can relate the exercises to an existing farm, cooperative, processor, project, or value chain. Climate-resilient food systems roles supported by this training include:
modules: Waste Valorization for Feed and Fertilizer
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to farm operations, food processing, agricultural value chains, agribusiness development, or climate and livelihoods programming. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet literacy helps because you will calculate selected resource, emissions, and financial indicators in Excel. Bring a laptop if possible; supplied templates support participants who use alternative spreadsheet software.
